title: MERFISHEYES dataset metadata
description: The metadata a MERFISHEYES store carries in its root zarr.json attributes (docs/specs/metadata.md). metadata_general and metadata_<technology> are SpatialData-DB's blocks, written as they write them; meyes_metadata holds the ontology ids and our columns, named as the query index names them; meyes_provenance says who wrote it and what validated it. $defs/indexRow is one row of the query index: SpatialData-DB catalog schema 3 plus meyes_ columns. x-meyes-level is our profile's level for the column (required, recommended, optional, derived by the index build, n/a); x-sddb-dtype is the column's dtype in their _catalog_schema.py. Producers may add keys; readers ignore what they do not know.

metadataGeneral.description: SpatialData-DB's metadata_general (General Metadata Version 0.3.2): labels, not ids. Keys we do not write: Database Version, Count Matrix Hash; SpatialData-IO Version only when spatialdata-io read the input.

License.description: The licence's label (`CC BY 4.0`), not its id.

technologyBlock.description: SpatialData-DB's per-technology block, e.g. metadata_merscope {"Merscope Metadata Version": "0.1.0"} for MERFISH and MERSCOPE stores.

meyesMetadata.description: Every index column that is a fact about the data, named as in $defs/indexRow, plus version. Columns about where or when the store is published (uid, zarr_url, card_url, size_bytes, published_at, meyes_id, meyes_*_url, validation_status) are not here: they belong to the index and Lamin.

provenance.description: Mirrors SpatialData-DB's sddb_provenance for stores we write.

pipeline.description: Git short sha of the code that wrote the store.

sources.description: Column -> where its value came from: bil-api, bil-csv, owner, curator, store, agent-proposed (confirmed by a person), sddb.
Ontology -> version used, equal to conventions.json metadata.ontologies.

matrix.description: What was hashed: `X`, or `layers/<name>` when X is not counts.

sketch.description: The 64 smallest per-cell hashes (16 hex digits each), sorted: a bottom-k sketch to estimate the share of cells two stores have in common.

id.description: The section's name in the store (the _sample_id of its cells).

meyes_matrix_hash.description: The section's own matrix hash, so one section re-released alone is found.

indexRow.description: One row of the query index (catalog.parquet): SpatialData-DB catalog schema 3 (all 93 columns, their order) then the meyes_ columns. `required` is the interim set, while the fleet is reprocessed; x-meyes-required-after-reprocessing lists the columns that join it when that is done (METADATA.md M10), which makes SpatialData-DB's six required columns required again.

uid.description: Lamin artifact uid of the store in merfisheyes/eyes-catalog. Required once the fleet is reprocessed and registered (FINAL_REQUIRED).

canonical_key.description: `bil:<code>` for a BIL dataset, else `meyes:<CatalogDataset id>`.

study_id.description: Same scheme as canonical_key; `doi:<doi>` when the dataset is one of a paper's.

collection_name.description: Slug of the dataset's first collection.

organism.description: bionty Organism name, lower case, as SDDB writes it (`mouse`, `human`, `macaque`).

tissue.description: UBERON term name; `unknown` when not stated.

tissue_id.description: UBERON CURIE; null only when tissue is `unknown`.

disease_id.description: MONDO CURIE, PATO:0000461 for `normal`, null for `unknown`.

tissue_system.description: From the pinned UBERON graph and SDDB's tissue anchor table.

disease_class.description: From the pinned MONDO graph and SDDB's disease anchor table.

technology.description: An id of technology.json (`merfish`, `vizgen_merscope`, `10x_xenium`, …). Required once the fleet is reprocessed (FINAL_REQUIRED).

vendor.description: The technology's vendor_id in technology.json. Required once the fleet is reprocessed (FINAL_REQUIRED).

variant.description: One of the technology's variant ids.

assay.description: The technology's first legacy_assay label in technology.json. Required once the fleet is reprocessed (FINAL_REQUIRED).

validation_status.description: `pass` once bionty passes every ontology column (M3).

tier.description: Not filled until SDDB's tier rule is known (open).

license.description: Licence vocabulary id (SPDX style, SDDB's ids plus ours).

non_integer_counts.description: True when X holds non-integer values; the pipeline knows.

n_features.description: Columns of the default table (genes, blanks and controls filtered).

zarr_url.description: `s3://bucket/key.zarr` of the store, as SDDB writes it.

card_url.description: The store's artifact page in Lamin eyes-catalog.

vitessce_url.description: Null: the viewer link is meyes_viewer_url.

size_bytes.description: Bytes of the store, from the S3 listing.

published_at.description: ISO 8601 time the row first entered the index.

pathological.description: False for `normal`, true for a MONDO disease, null for `unknown`.

review_status.description: `under_review` while a review is open (M3), else null.

product.description: The vendor's product name (`MERSCOPE`, `MERFISH`, `In Situ Gene Expression`).

hne_image.description: The store has an H&E image element.

if_image.description: The store has a fluorescence image element (DAPI, PolyT, morphology).

mpp.description: Microns per pixel of the full-resolution image.

sdata_repr.description: print(sdata) of the store, written by our formatter (spatialdata 0.8 cannot read our points).

n_transcripts.description: Molecules in the store's points elements, all sections.

publication_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD the data was published at its source (BIL submission date).

sample_id.description: The source's id for the sample: the BIL code for a BIL store.

donor_id.description: Set when every section has the same donor; else per section.

database_version.description: SDDB's own version; null (ours is meyes_pipeline).

dataset_url.description: The source's page (the BIL dataset page).

timepoint.description: The source's text (`28.0 Days`, `20.0 Gestational weeks`).

timepoint_days.description: Days since birth (age) or since conception (stage).

observation_unit_source.description: `technology_map`, as SDDB for stores whose table does not record it.

segmentation_source.description: `depositor` (cells came from the depositor's table) or `vendor` (the instrument's output).

same_section_group.description: Re-release group: rows whose matrix is the same (equal meyes_matrix_hash, or a near match a person confirmed). The newest member's uid (canonical_key until uids exist). metadata.md §7.7.

same_section_relation.description: `rerelease` within a group, as SpatialData-DB writes it; null outside one.

meyes_id.description: The CatalogDataset id: the Explore page.

meyes_viewer_url.description: Opens the store in the viewer.

meyes_description.description: Free text; SDDB rows have none (their collections carry abstracts).

meyes_sex.description: `male`, `female`, `mixed sex` (PATO names); SDDB has no sex column.

meyes_sex_id.description: PATO CURIE: PATO:0000384 male, PATO:0000383 female, PATO:0001338 mixed sex.

meyes_development_stage_id.description: HsapDv / MmusDv CURIE of development_stage (SDDB publishes the name only).

meyes_sections.description: One entry per section: id, sample_id, donor_id, timepoint, n_obs, n_transcripts (M6).

meyes_de_columns.description: obs columns with DE statistics in the store.

meyes_matrix_hash.description: `mh1:` + sha256 of the default table's counts, independent of storage, cell order and gene order (metadata.md §7.7). Equal hashes = the same matrix.

meyes_pipeline.description: Git short sha of the code that wrote the store; null for a store we did not write.

meyes_pipeline_input.description: What prepare.py recognised the input as.

meyes_n_molecule_genes.description: Genes in the points elements (may include blanks).

meyes_cell_type_levels.description: Taxonomy levels present as obs columns.
